findings.summary: onCreateResult fires before education/experience sub-requests complete
findings.detail: In CandidateForm.tsx, onCreateResult is called immediately after POST /api/v1/candidates resolves (lines 279-281), before the education/experience PUT/POST loops run (lines 295-350). If the user navigates away via the DuplicateWarningBanner or BlacklistWarningModal, any unsaved education/experience data is abandoned. Fix: move the onCreateResult call to after the sub-request loops complete, alongside the showToast('success') call at line 352.

findings.summary: StatusBadge 'uploading' label reads 'Sedang diupload' instead of planned 'Terkirim — AI sedang memproses'
findings.detail: The fix plan specified the uploading badge should communicate post-upload async AI processing. The implementation uses 'Sedang diupload' (accurate during HTTP transfer) and transitions immediately to 'Berhasil diekstrak' on success — never showing the AI-processing state. Non-blocking cosmetic divergence from the plan.

The modal sets role=dialog and aria-modal=true but does not move focus on open or trap it inside. Keyboard users can tab through background content while the modal is visible. Non-blocking for current usage.
